stories.title: One Click on a Malicious Link Lets Hackers Backdoor Sogou Input Method Users
stories.description: A one-click Sogou Input Method flaw let UNC3569 deploy GRAYRABBIT backdoor, enabling remote code execution and data theft.

stories.title: The Race to Control AI and Protect What Makes Us Human
stories.description: As researchers warn that misaligned AI could threaten human survival, even beneficial systems may erode the critical thinking that defines our humanity.

stories.title: AI Changed the Exposure Problem. Validation Needs to Change With It.
stories.description: 35,853 CVEs were published in H1 2026, but 495 were catalogued as exploited in the wild, sharpening the case for exposure validation.

stories.title: Chinese Hackers Exploit Critical Tencent Software Flaw for One-Click Code Execution
stories.description: The Chinese-language input method editor for Windows can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely.

stories.title: Hackers Leverage Claude to Exfiltrate Secrets from 1.8M Android apps
stories.description: ShinyHunters-linked criminals used Claude to scan 1.8M Android apps for hardcoded secrets, turning exposed credentials into rapid enterprise access.

stories.title: Microsoft Confirms Remote Desktop Services Might Stop Working Following Sept. 2026 Security Update
stories.description: Microsoft has confirmed that its September 2026 Windows security updates can destabilize Remote Desktop Services (RDS), potentially disrupting remote administration across a broad range of enterprise endpoints and servers.

stories.title: CISOs Race to Control AI Agents Without Destroying Their Value
stories.description: Security leaders are struggling to modernize cyber hygiene and prevent over-privileged agents from causing unintended harm.

stories.title: GitHub Pays $100,000 Bounty for Critical RCE Flaw in Git Push Pipeline
stories.description: GitHub awarded researcher Saif Ghani a $100,000 bug bounty for discovering CVE-2026-3854, a RCE flaw in GitHub’s Git push processing pipeline.

stories.title: Malicious Twitch Browser Extension Leaks OAuth Tokens From Nearly 31,000 Users
stories.description: JeetBot's Twitch extension sent OAuth tokens from nearly 31,000 users to operator-controlled proxies; Firefox 85.8.7 stops the behavior.
